---
title: "About"
---

This blog covers interactive, reproducible scientific visualization in **R** with
[canvasXpress](https://canvasxpress.org) — the R interface to the CanvasXpress engine.

The idea in one line: a figure is a **portable JSON specification** (`data` + `config`). The
same spec renders identically from R, Python and JavaScript, and can be stored, validated,
compared and reproduced — so a plot behaves like code.

- Package (CRAN): `install.packages("canvasXpress")`
- Source & issues: [github.com/neuhausi/canvasXpress](https://github.com/neuhausi/canvasXpress)
- Gallery and docs: [canvasxpress.org](https://canvasxpress.org)

Posts here are hands-on R recipes: paste one, swap in your data.
